## Publish gate report

**Going out:** landing page hero, UK audience, no date given.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | On the policy list |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list |
| "most boxes ship free" | **Unproven.** Nothing in the policy or this chat says most orders pass £25. It is an implied statistic about order values. |

**Regulated claims (prices and offers):** the free delivery condition (over £25) is stated, so that part is fine. "Most boxes ship free" would blur it, because it suggests free delivery is the norm.

**Disclosure:** not needed. This is the brand's own page, with no ad, sponsor, affiliate link or AI-labelled content.

**House style:** no banned words or AI tells that I can see. The copy is short and plain. It would score above 80, and I changed nothing for style.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite):**
> Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

I cut "means most boxes ship free". The rewrite keeps the selling point and uses only what the policy backs.

**Needs a decision:**
- If you have real data showing most orders exceed £25, share it and I can add it to the policy and restore the line. I suggest leaving it out.
- The policy names no approver for this type of content, so I need an explicit yes to the exact rewritten copy from you or whoever owns the landing page. Nothing is approved yet, and I haven't recorded an approval.
